surface: Public webgpu.h ABI, Apple Metal, dynamically loaded provider inside setupNs
workloadOrigin: unchanged amd-host C1 workloads; inputs manifest byte-identical to the amd-host and intel-host manifests (afe4e1d3...); independent CPU oracle on every iteration outside the timed interval

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of the 4 providers, cycled

timing: CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW (Darwin CLOCK_MONOTONIC is quantized to 1 us); host clock, not GPU timestamps
phases: identical to amd-host contract-c1.json; complete = compile + pipeline + resources + sum of every iteration's operation + teardown
statistics: per-pair ratio provider/control; median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029), provider-faster pair count
gateLimits: Unchanged from b2/b3/m1r/m2r: idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity (tools/mac_window.py, hash below).
gpuLock: Every timed window runs under `flock /tmp/doe-gpu-timing.lock`, the host-wide lock shared with other agents' Metal correctness and timing runs, held for that window only; scheduling (settle loop, tools/wait_quiet.sh) runs outside the lock.

host.label: apple-host
host.machine: Apple M3 (8 CPU cores, 10 GPU cores), 24 GiB unified memory
host.power: Battery power at freeze; low power off. Gates record actual battery before/after and reject changes of source.
host.sharedUse: Live desktop and agent sessions. No host identity retained. Scheduler outside GPU lock; every GPU process under host-wide flock.

rebuild: ZERO_AR_DATE=1 make -C runtime/c/native -j8 BUILD=<work>/build-next/native CC=clang; archive of 125654e63 + submit-sparse/candidate.patch
experiment: Bind only occupied buffer slots on each fresh compute encoder, retaining sparse slot identity and full zero-filled size table. Direct and indirect compute share this operation. No storage candidate changes are present.

providers.dawn: Dawn d04f88359391a12375c1a3e948a0b2dcb4c97a18, rebuilt ZERO_AR_DATE=1, handoff retained build

harness: build --backend metal --load-provider --upload-split. Executable links only libSystem (otool verified); exact provider dlopen, all dlsym and linked framework work occur after setup t0. Preloaded provider or Foundation/Metal/IOSurface/CoreVideo fails closed. providerLoadNs nested inside setupNs. setupInstanceNs excludes providerLoadNs so nested subphases sum to setupNs. Driver loading remains inside setup. No framework preload step.
ruleChange: Prospective setup boundary correction explicitly requested by owner: load each provider at same point after setup timer start. Prior setup results keep their historical meaning. Upload split and bounds unchanged from m1s.

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports a Metal adapter that is not a CPU adapter
A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median ratio within [0.95,1.05] and its CI95 contains 1, per workload
window gate (tools/mac_window.py) valid: power source and low-power mode unchanged, no thermal warning, idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity
acceptance.mechanismRule: cand/main vector warm.submit CI upper < 1. All noRegress metrics CI lower <= 1.05 on all three workloads. Copy/readback is unchanged by this mechanism and remains bounded and reported. 81/81 Metal physical client status matches main before freeze; backend check, sdk-abi, native-check, native-graphics-check pass.
acceptance.invalidWindows: At most two attempts per workload. A window is invalid if environment gate fails, process/oracle/provider checks fail, or A/A warm.operation median outside [0.95,1.05] or CI excludes 1. Retain invalid attempts. Same contract for one rerun. No retry based on performance outcome.
acceptance.claimBoundary: A pass accepts the mechanism for the Metal C runtime on apple-host only; it does not by itself make a scoped win against Dawn and says nothing about Vulkan or D3D12.

relation: Prospective same-binary follow-up requested by continuation. Original sparse contract exhausted two foreign-CPU-invalid windows and remains inconclusive. No performance ratios from invalid windows select this follow-up. All source/binary hashes, workloads, sampling, A/A, gates and acceptance rules are unchanged; all three workloads run fresh.
